A''' scepter''' was a staff wielded by many beings as symbol of wealth, control, or power.

==History==
The [[Scepter of Ragnos]] was a powerful [[Dark side artifact/Legends|dark side artifact]] used by the deceased [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Marka Ragnos]], and later by the [[Disciples of Ragnos]]. The [[Tammuz-an royal scepter]] was a symbol that the wielder was the rightful ruler of [[Tammuz-an/Legends|Tammuz-an]]. The [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] believed a staff known as the [[season scepter]] could control the seasons of their forest moon. The [[Supreme Overlord]] of the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] race was granted a [[Scepter of Power]], an [[amphistaff]] specially bioengineered for that leader. Similarly, a [[Scepter of Entreaty]] was worn by anyone who wished to make a plea before the Supreme Overlord.

Though not formally called a scepter, the [[Speaker's staff/Legends|Speaker's staff]] was a form of scepter utilized by the [[Vice Chair/Legends|Vice Chair]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]]. It demonstrated the authority the wielder held over senate debates.
